verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs offer official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Fleet and the rest of the stack. That is agent-oriented guidance an agent can be pointed at. However, probes found no llms.txt (404) and no markdown docs endpoint (docs.md, 404) at elastic.co, so the standard machine-readable doc entry points are absent. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt or llms-full.txt, markdown or agent-readable docs endpoints, and detailed documentation or hands-on corroboration of the agent skills.
